entries.title: Automatic App runs: 33/7/81 on b78fffb1 to 118/2/1 on efed6fae

failures.note: Automatic App run on b78fffb1 failed: the inverted-range error toast rendered outside the open Clips dialog, so it was inert and absent from the accessibility tree. Fixed in e43248c0; the automatic App run on 48f9b999 passed the same case. The PR check as a whole is still red.

failures.case: S4-PAL-04 — Cycle tracks keep their range.
failures.note: Automatic App run on 2d27b262 found 6 Hz and 5.5 Hz marked invalid by the rate input. Fixed in f2f13f3c; the follow-up pass was a manual controlled run, and the automatic App run on 53ac2afe passed the same case.

failures.case: S4-RELATION-01 — Turn it around, and bring it back.
failures.note: Automatic App run on 48f9b999 failed because the agent could not find the transform controls: their accessible names were only glyphs (fixed in ff320663). Reproducing it exposed data loss: after a selection was lifted with H or V, Escape deleted it with no Undo, and Undo after Commit or Ctrl+D returned to the cut-out hole (fixed in c534cc99, with tests/e2e/selectionTransformUndo.spec.ts). The automatic App run on 0259f782 passed the redesigned case on the fixed build.

Automatic App run on 9c2197d2 failed: typing 24 into the Canvas size Width field gave 44, because the field clamped to 4–512 on every keystroke (the 2 snapped to 4 before the 4 arrived), so Apply resized to 44×44 and no size starting with 1, 2 or 3 could be typed. Reproduced with real key events in Chromium and WebKit on the deployed preview. Fixed in 4d838ca9 with tests/components/CanvasResizeModal.test.tsx; the automatic App run on 53ac2afe passed the same case.

The complete automatic cohort and ten retained failures are in automatic-followup-2026-10-19.json. Double Undo, wrong-frame layer checks and a safe export fixture are diagnosed; not every non-pass has a confirmed cause. Separate local/manual passes do not replace App verdicts.

Support AI confirmed shared fixture uploads are excluded on Free. Saved-Python/App execution remains unknown. The prior manually retried 32/13/76 cohort is retained in pr6-triage-2026-10-19.json. This automatic check failed; no completed red-to-green loop is claimed.

The three failures and two blocks were plan or runner issues, not product defects: S4-FX-03 read a readout field as blank, S4-PAL-01 expected a colour-count suffix that the Labs palette picker does not show, S4-HOME-01 clicked bench art that did not register, S4-ANIM-02 never pressed Play, and S4-LEARN-06 ran below 1024 px. Their plans were simplified to what the agent reliably observes. The required PR check is still red until a run passes all 121.

All five plans simplified after 53ac2afe passed. The two failures and one block were plan issues: S4-EXPORT-05 could not read the inline refusal text after a Download click (the preflight already names the problem), S4-NEW-03 still carried an older description asking for file oracles the agent cannot use, and S4-VIEW-02 skipped its workspace-preset steps. Their plans were simplified and republished; the required PR check stays red until a run passes all 121.
